annotations.text:
Assumptions to check
• Domain: handwrittenjournal.app is assumed (available, not yet registered). The footer, email and links use it.
• Email: hello@handwrittenjournal.app is the placeholder the one-pagers already use.
• App Store: the black pill stands in for Apple's official badge asset; the link is empty until the app is listed.
• The one-pager and press-kit cards link nowhere until the PDFs are uploaded.
• Hero: a placeholder frame for the 30-second preview video (autoplay muted, captions).
• Screenshots are the simulator drafts with synthesised handwriting; reshoot on a real iPad.
• Beyond the GTM plan §5.5 list, two sections were added: Marked as they write, and Settings, not rewards. Both are easy to cut.
